items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Before you went to college though, you were playing with Troy Floyd, 1930. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, uh-huh.

ctx.x: And so tell me about how you got to T. Holder's (inaudible).
Well, T. Holder -- I went to T. Holder before Troy Floyd, actually.
